Descriptions

DESCRIPTION

This chest of drawers should not be missing in any apartment. Durable and expressive wood Use soft solid wood colours to create a cosy and warm living area. MORE STORAGE - The sideboard consists of 2 wooden doors and 2 drawers. So storage is taken care of! Easy assembly - Thanks to the detailed instructions, the wooden chest of drawers can be set up quickly and easily and is therefore also suitable for beginners. Installation material included. Dimensions: 60*120*40cm (W/H/D). Rattan Fabric Door Panel: It is beautiful and stylish, prevents dust from entering, and makes daily cleaning easier. High-quality materials: Certified E1 chipboard keeps you away from chemical odors. The thicker version of the board is matched with solid pine wood legs, which significantly increases the stability of the product, and the properly assembled cabinet will not wobble. Stylish Design: The solid wood color cabinet is matched with woven PE rattan, which enhances the shape and design of the product. No hinge: The door panels are designed to be very easy to install while reducing noise. Scope of delivery - Scope of delivery: 1 sideboard/chest of drawers, metal handle and mounting hardware. Product Size: Strong and durable, suitable for daily use Push to open: Just pull it lightly, the easy-to-open wooden door design and smooth sliding rail drawer save your time and effort, and there is magnetic adsorption when the wooden door is closed. MULTI-PURPOSE: This sideboard can be used as a chest of drawers in the kitchen, as a bookcase, TV stand, storage cabinet, or as a presentation shelf in the living room. This sideboard looks great in your living room or dining room, it is available in a natural wood color. 2 wooden doors and 2 drawers provide plenty of space to store dishes, boxes, and more. All surfaces are waterproof and easy to clean.
